result.summary: Found 1 major issue: an invalid '-100%' discount badge displayed on the bottom restaurant card.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom of the 'Popular right now' section displays an unrealistic '-100%' promotional discount badge, likely caused by a pricing calculation error or missing price data.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount calculation logic so valid promotional percentages are shown, and hide the discount badge when discount data is invalid, zero, or unavailable.
